name: qqqqq
newText: After the purchase, I contacted a specialized service center for professional installation of the component, for which I paid 500 UAH. However, the computer started working unstably and stopped turning on. To identify the cause of the malfunction, I was forced to contact the service center again and pay another 1000 UAH for an in-depth system diagnosis. According to the diagnostic results, it was determined that the cause of the malfunction was a factory defect in the processor, which operates unstably (“every other time”), while the other components of my PC (motherboard, PSU, RAM) are functioning properly.
